Studio and two-bedroom priced examples have slightly different areas from the illustrated sheets. The 34.68 sqm corner price remains on inquiry.

projects.overviewNote: Compare the documented 25.24 sqm Studio, 42.32 sqm one-bedroom and 68.00 sqm two-bedroom layouts. The Cubao location offers access to the MRT-3 and LRT-2 stations, Araneta City shopping and entertainment destinations.
pricingNotes: The Studio’s ₱2.3M figure is an undated estimate on the developer’s website, checked 15 October 2026. Its tax, fee and payment basis is unstated. The supplied one- and two-bedroom net list examples are dated 25 September 2026 and expired on 2 October 2026; these include the stated 12% VAT, with title-transfer, move-in and other charges extra.
